title: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Language Models with Task-Specific Exam Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Computing a fixed-answer baseline to detect if the LLM disproportionately favors specific candidate answer positions (e.g., frequently choosing the first option) during multiple-choice evaluations.
Computing a longest-answer baseline to evaluate whether the LLM is biased toward systematically selecting the longest candidate text in multiple-choice exams.

Analyzing the dataset's distribution of question types using Bloom's Taxonomy and semantic typing (e.g., what, where, who) to identify and mitigate structural imbalances in cognitive complexity and question formats.
